faq.a: Abdelwahab is associated with the Arabic form عَبْدُ الْوَهَّاب, whose core sense is abdelwahab; servant of the bestower.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdelwahab?
faq.a: Abdelwahab is associated with Arabic. Abdelwahab is Arabic عَبْدُ الْوَهَّاب (ʿAbd al-Wahhāb), meaning 'servant of the Bestower'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْوَهَّاب is Arabic.
Abdelwahab can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdelwahab should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Wahhāb is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdelwahab mean in Urdu?

faq.q: What does Abdelwahab mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Abdelwahab is rendered عبدالوهاب and carries the sense عبدالوهاب، بنده وهّاب.
A romanized syllable approximation is ab-del-wa-hab. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Abdelwahab, abdelwahab. Script forms are عبدالوهاب, عبدالوہاب, عَبْدُ الْوَهَّاب, अब्देलवह्हाब.
